candidate.topic: Sleep diary before the CBT-I decision
candidate.why_now: Your September 28 CBT-I session is when you plan to decide whether to extend therapy. With five days left, restarting your sleep diary now could give you information for that choice.
candidate.what_changed: You recorded that the September 28 session will inform whether to extend therapy and that you stopped your sleep diary. The available watch records cover September 2–23, but the earlier analysis noted that time asleep alone does not capture sleep quality or daytime function.
candidate.unknowns: The available records do not establish whether your insomnia is better than before CBT-I. A diary started now would show how the remaining days go, but without comparable earlier entries it could not establish how much things changed during the course or whether CBT-I caused a change.
candidate.next_step: Complete a sleep diary each morning until the session, noting estimated time to fall asleep, time awake during the night, and how sleep affected the following day. Compare it with any earlier diary entries you have. That could help you decide whether the remaining sleep difficulties warrant discussing an extension; without earlier comparable entries, use it to describe current difficulties rather than claim improvement.
